name: list_sessions
description: List the developer's coding sessions with state (working, needs_you, done), folder, when they last wrote to it, what it is doing and a preview of what it last said. By default only the sessions they are actively working in. Use scope "all" or a query to find an older one.

query.description: Part of a session title or folder name.

name: read_session
description: Read the last messages of one session.

name: send_message
description: Send a message to a session, as if the developer had typed it. A busy session queues it.

name: interrupt_session
description: Stop the turn a session is running, like pressing Escape.

name: edit_last_message
description: Correct the last message sent to a session: stops it if it is running, rewinds to just before that message (like /undo, including its file changes) and sends the corrected text.

name: start_session
description: Start a new session in a folder with a first task. folder is a path, a folder name the developer has used, or "same" for the folder of the session being discussed.

name: watch_session
description: Tell the developer when a session finishes or needs them.
